name: [🌟2x XP] Dragon Orbz
desc:
Current level cap: 600
Current Orbs in the game: 
Bob, Demon, Green Creature, Tanks, Pickle, Robot-17, Freezer, Cilium, Rohan, Pinky, Prince, Helfa, Supreme Shell, Roku, Giren, Rage, Cat-God, Angel

Hints:
- An orb will spawn every hour and will despawn fairly quickly find them fast!
- You can buy new orbs that are in stock from the Orb Dealer in North City!
- You should take on bosses with more than one person!

Controls
C - Charge
Q - Lock On
Shift - Sprint
Ctrl - Block
Double Space - Fly

Characters and Places based on DBZ
